title: CS 347: Operating Systems – Department Academic Mentorship Program
description: # CS 347: Operating Systems. **Motivation:** Basic concepts of Operating Systems like process abstraction, process execution. **Feedback on lectures and tutorials:** The lectures were held in LA with a strength of 95 students. The lectures given were insightful, interesting and all the concepts were taught really well, with sufficient time given to each topic. Lecture slides were used, but the professor insisted on taking notes as the slides were brief. There was an online page maintained for the course where video lectures, practice problems, and relevant course materials were uploaded. **Feedback on exams and assignments:** There were no labs for the course. After completion of a major topic, a programming assignment was given to us, to be completed in three weeks. There were a total of 3 such assignments, which were quite tough, but it gave us good enough. There were 2 quizzes conducted, both of them were of medium level with theoretical and logical questions. + Department Academic Mentorship Program* Already have a WordPress.com account?

title: CS 347 (2019-20) Review | Department Academic Mentorship Programme
description: **Motivation:** A very interesting and practical course that deals with the functioning of operating systems since we usually deal with different operating systems whenever we use our computers. The details of the lab course can be found in the review for CS 333. **Exams:** In our course offering, there were 2 quizzes contributing 15% each towards the final garde, a mid-semester exam contributing 30% towards the final grade and an end-semester exam contributing 40% towards the final grade. The end-semester exam included all the topics covered in the course with more weightage given to topics covered after mid-semester exam. If this course is interesting to you and if you want to explore more in this area, you can take up CS 695 (Topics in Virtualization and Cloud Computing) which is a more advanced course in the area of Operating Systems. **Advanced courses:** CS 695: Topics in Virtualization and Cloud Computing.

title: Lectures on Operating Systems
description: ## Lectures on Operating Systems. The material consists of video lectures, slides, practice problems with solutions, programming lab assignments, and additional reading material for reference. It is also possible to do the basics and xv6 parts together (studying one concept in OSTEP and following it up with understanding the same concept in xv6) by viewing the lectures in this order: Processes (1, 21, 2, 22, 3, 23, 4, 24-26, 5-6), Memory management (7-11, 27-28), Concurrency (12-16, 29-30), and Filesystems (17-20, 31-32). **Related video courses:** Links to other related courses for which I have made lecture videos available:  * Virtualization and Cloud Computing * Design and Engineering of Computer Systems  **Other textbooks:** Besides OSTEP, the following online/physical textbooks give a good end-to-end understanding of computer systems. lectures, slides, practice problems with solutions, programming lab assignments, and additional reading material for reference.
